sources.title: OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-ClinicalE5-Base-109M-v1 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-ClinicalE5-Base-109M-v1 is a transformer-based token classification model fine-tuned for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in Portuguese text. This model identifies and classifies 54 types of sensitive information including names, addresses, social security numbers, medical record numbers, and more.

sources.title: OpenMed's 109M Portuguese Clinical PII Model Now Available on Modelers ...
sources.snippet: Modelers.cn has released a new specialised model designed to address this specific pain point: OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-ClinicalE5-Base-109M-v1-mlx. This compact 109-million-parameter encoder is specifically engineered to identify and flag personally identifiable information (PII) spans within Portuguese clinical documents.
